personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK (optimized for high-speed POS utility)
personality_one_liner: A sophisticated, high-contrast command center that blends premium jewellery aesthetics with lightning-fast counter billing functionality.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (>=48px) for POS speed. Use 'lg' padding for tabular rows and 'xl' for sticky action areas.

do's: Use blur on sticky headers, bottom tab bar, and the persistent payment panel in Billing.
Use translucent tinted backgrounds (brandTertiary at 70% opacity) behind text overlaid on images.
dont's: Never blur dense tabular data or form inputs.
Avoid glass on standard list items.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview of daily performance and critical alerts.

states.empty: No data for today yet - start billing.

screens.layout: Grid of 6 KPI cards using 'surfaceSecondary' with 'brandTertiary' subtle borders. Today's Sales card is featured larger with 'brandPrimary' text. Keep typography large (2xl) for numeric values using Space Grotesk.

screens.name: Billing

states.empty: Illustration of empty cart with 'Add items to begin bill'.

screens.layout: Top section: Customer mobile input field. Middle: Dropdown picker for items, qty input, and a tabular list of added items (Item Name, Qty, Price, Remove). Bottom: Sticky glassmorphic panel containing Gross Amount, Auto 10% Discount tag (if >699), Cash/UPI split inputs (allowing negative UPI for change), and a massive 'Complete Bill' pill button.

screens.name: Inventory
screens.purpose: Manage product catalog and track stock levels.

states.empty: Illustration of empty shelf. 'Add your first product'.

screens.layout: Header with search bar and horizontal scrolling category filter chips. Main view: List of items. Items with qty <= 5 have a prominent red 'error' surface badge. Floating action button (FAB) for adding new items using 'brandPrimary'.

screens.name: Sales History
screens.purpose: Review past bills and check payment statuses.

states.empty: No sales found for the selected period.

screens.layout: Sticky horizontal filter row (Today, Yesterday, Month, Custom) below header. List of bills showing Bill ID, Time, Customer Mobile, Amount, and a strict PAID/DRAFT status badge (success/error tokens).

screens.name: Invoice Preview
screens.purpose: Digital receipt view for sharing or printing.
screens.layout: Modal view. Uses 'surfaceInverse' (white) background with 'onSurfaceInverse' (black) text to simulate real paper receipts. Monospace or highly tabular layout for line items. Share/Print buttons sticky at bottom.

login_hero.alt: Abstract luxury gold and black texture

empty_state_jewellery.alt: Gold necklace on dark reflective background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Luxe palette: midnight black/obsidian surfaces with antique gold accents. Do NOT use any blue or purple.

Implement the sticky CTA pattern for the Billing screen's payment panel. The Gross Amount, Cash/UPI split inputs, and 'Complete Bill' button MUST be in a sticky bottom view with glassmorphism, ensuring they are always reachable without scrolling.
Typography: Use Space Grotesk for all numeric values (prices, quantities, KPIs) to ensure readability and a POS command-center feel. Use Geist for standard labels.
Apply a 10% auto-discount rule in the Billing flow if the cart total exceeds ₹699.
In the Billing flow, ensure the UPI input can handle negative values to explicitly show change returned to the customer.
Inventory low stock: Apply the red `error` badge to any item where quantity is <= 5.
Invoice Preview screen MUST use the `surfaceInverse` (white) background so it actually looks like a printable receipt.
